one_sentence_story: A source folio emits one amber trace into a transparent Context Capsule; a single 90-degree hinge-gate locks that trace to a cusp fibre, wakes a torus family, and closes beside a qualified S6 paper claim with a separate world-trace receipt.

beats.visual: Dark hexagonal terrain. One upright ivory source folio at x=-5.4 emits exactly one warm amber filament to the right; no dashboard or pseudo-text.
beats.transition: The filament is the only moving object; the folio stays fixed.

beats.visual: The filament crosses into a glass rectangular Context Capsule at x=-1.5. Three translucent planes align around it, showing bounded context as volume rather than UI.
beats.transition: The amber core gains a cyan edge but remains one continuous stream.

beats.visual: At x=1.0, a small hexagonal cusp fibre sits on a graphite hinge. The trace reaches it; the hinge rotates exactly 90 degrees and locks. The torus family remains dim and closed.
beats.transition: Closed means not linked; open means the trace is carried forward.

beats.visual: The locked cusp pulls the cyan filament through three nested torus rings at x=2.7. The rings light once in sequence and settle as one stable family; a fine line continues right.
beats.transition: The same rings persist before and after the link; only their illumination changes.

beats.visual: At x=5.1, a pale paper sheet receives the cyan line and folds into a restrained hexagonal closure. A separate circular world-trace marker sits outside it. The only readable copy is: 'S6 PAPER CLAIM' and 'TRACE-LINKED, NOT CONSENSUS'.
beats.transition: The final state is closed but qualified: a paper claim with a trace, not a consensus fact.

caption_script.text: Context gives the trace a boundary.
A hinge makes the link legible.
The linked trace closes a torus family.
S6 is a paper claim with a world trace, not consensus.

manim_plan.text_policy: Render only explicit labels with a bundled deterministic font; no generated pseudo-text.

falsifier: The concept fails if a viewer cannot identify the hinge rotation as the single acceptance move, or if the final S6 paper claim reads as verified consensus without the qualifier and separate world-trace marker.
